name: Heddle
description: Installs Heddle and registers it as an s6-overlay service.

configFile.description: Absolute path to the bind-mounted Heddle configuration file.

stateDirectory.description: Absolute path to the bind-mounted Heddle state directory.

githubAppCredentialsFile.description: Absolute path to the bind-mounted GitHub App credential file.

t3CodeTokenFile.description: Absolute path to the bind-mounted T3 Code bearer-token file.

webhookSecretFile.description: Absolute path to the bind-mounted GitHub webhook secret file.

serviceUser.description: User that runs Heddle. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, vscode, then root.
